user_story: As a user, I want to fill out the contact form on the Automation Exercise website so that I can send feedback or inquiries. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The contact form should include fields for 'Name', 'Email', 'Subject', and 'Your Message Here'. 2. The 'Submit' button should be present and functional. 3. Upon submitting the form with valid data, the user should remain on the same page and see the success message for subscription. 4. Submitting the form without filling in any fields should not change the URL.
